kinds.description: Per-person sidebar preferences. List order is sidebar order. One record per person is not enforced by this definition; a host-owned per-person slot is planned for that. Focus id shapes are NOT enforced by the store in this revision; they must be enforced by a Foci consumer. Tier is a closed choice (now, background) enforced by the store. No audience-change guard exists yet: a write is not fenced against a concurrent change to the home's access policy.

fields.name: foci
focus_id
fields.description: Focus id. The shape must be enforced by a Foci consumer; this package does not enforce it. The interpreter's 4,096-byte text ceiling still applies.

fields.name: hidden
fields.description: Whether this focus is hidden in the sidebar.
Sidebar foci in display order. May be empty.
